visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a young woman standing on a street next to a metal fence. She has her hair up in a bun with a white scrunchie and is wearing a black jacket with a white fur collar, a white shirt, and light blue jeans. She smiles at the camera while shifting her posture. Buildings and a road with a few pedestrians are visible in the background. (2) The scene shifts to a close-up of a white surface. A pair of hands reaches into a grey shopping bag featuring the Vivienne Westwood logo. They pull out a grey dust bag with the same logo and then extract a black drawstring bag from within it. (3) The camera focuses on the details of the black bag. It shows the adjustable black leather strap with silver buckles and the metallic lobster claw clips used to attach the strap to the bag's rings. (4) A variety of personal items are laid out on the white surface, including a green passport, a small silver camera, lipsticks, and a small tripod. The hands pick up each item individually and carefully place them into the main compartment of the black bag, demonstrating its capacity. (5) The woman returns to the street setting, leaning against the railing with the bag on her shoulder. She turns around to look upward at the sky and then turns back to smile warmly at the camera with her arms crossed.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female character, with approximately 3 blurred passers-by in the background of the street shots.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young woman with dark hair tied in a bun. She wears a black denim-style jacket with a cream-colored shearling collar, a white top, and light blue high-waisted denim jeans.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Outdoor scenes are set on a clean, residential Japanese street with low-rise apartment buildings and a black metal railing. Indoor scenes take place on a flat, white, minimalist surface likely used for product photography.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy J-pop track featuring distorted electric guitar riffs and a fast drum beat. A female vocalist sings in Japanese with high pitch and energetic delivery. There is a low level of background urban hum. (2) As the music continues, the sound of plastic and fabric rustling is clearly audible as the bag is handled and the dust bag is removed. The vocal melody remains upbeat and driving. (3) Small metallic clicks and clinks are heard periodically as the metal hardware and buckles of the bag are adjusted. The music maintains its high arousal and intensity throughout. (4) The rhythmic placing of objects into the bag creates subtle thudding sounds. The BGM remains dominant, with the singer's voice soaring over the dense instrumental mix.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a trendy lifestyle unboxing and capacity test for a Vivienne Westwood bag. It uses aesthetic street visuals and detailed product close-ups to appeal to fashion-conscious viewers, demonstrating both the brand's style and the bag's practicality for carrying daily travel essentials.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Prominent display of the brand's shopping bag, dust bag, and detailed logo shots, followed by a functional demonstration of the product.
